description:
Upstream provides three model-related shortcuts:
- Ctrl+P: cycle to next model
- Shift+Ctrl+P: cycle to previous model  
- Ctrl+L: open a full model selector overlay (select list)

Our Interactive has a ModelSelector component but no keyboard shortcut wires it in. The Ctrl+P/Shift+Ctrl+P cycling is also unimplemented.

Implement:
1. Ctrl+P / Shift+Ctrl+P: cycle through available models, update the session, show status notification.
2. Ctrl+L: show the ModelSelector overlay, let user pick, update session on confirm.

Ref: `interactive-mode.ts` L2349-2354, L3329-3340, `cycleModel()`, `showModelSelector()`.
title: Interactive: model cycling and model selector overlay
